MAR.note: Document states nothing on rules or an authority against AI harms.
Only AI training for 5,000 supervisors is stated; no government AI system.
No sectoral AI tool is stated.
No AI model, dataset or AI computing is stated.
No data centre for hire is named; the sovereign cloud is a commitment only.

facts.fact: The PLF 2027 presentation note, published by the Ministry of Economy and Finance, commits the government to store Moroccans' data in a sovereign national cloud in 2027, with the scope of data and timetable still to be set.

MAR.note: Nothing on government technical staff running systems; AI training is other.
No nationally owned data centre for hire is stated.
MAD 1.2 billion for startups is cited with no startup act, labelling or named fund.
No hub, incubator or park is stated.
